messages:
Mia Patel: Quick sync — Snowflake/Databricks connector onboarding. We need final sample dataset, mapping table, and telemetry schema for partner QA. Owners + ETA?
Jordan Lee: I'll own packaging of samples. Target: EOD Thu 2026-03-26. Will include both CSV and NDJSON.
Sam Torres: For telemetry, we need event names, cardinality estimates, and retention window. I'll draft spec in #eng-telemetry and link it here once ready.
Ellie Chen: Mapping table requirements: primary_key, partition_key, ingestion_ts, source_hash. Please include sample partitioning strategy for Snowflake (DATE) and Databricks (month).
Jordan Lee: Partner asked for sandbox creds — not in-channel. I'll DM @people-ops and drop them into #partners-secure once ready.
Mia Patel: @Sam @Ellie can you confirm backfill/test plan? We need to validate embeddings + vectorization on ~10k rows and perf under burst.
Sam Torres: Plan: local vectorize -> similarity sanity -> perf harness with batch_size=32 and async KV cache enabled. Minimal script to kick off sanity check:
```
# quick check
python -m connector_tests.run_vectorize --input sample.ndjson --model open-embedding-1 --batch 32
```
Jordan Lee: I'll add a small sample with mixed doc lengths and noise fields to catch schema drift. Also including a few rows with nulls in optional metadata.
PartnerBot: Task PART-4721 created and assigned to Jordan Lee. ETA set to 2026-03-26.
Ellie Chen: Also, add telemetry tags: `connector.install`, `connector.ingest.success`, `connector.ingest.failure`. Expect <50 distinct values per tag per hour.
Mia Patel: Action items recap: Jordan (samples + creds + noisy rows), Sam (telemetry spec + perf script), Ellie (mapping + telemetry tags). Uploads to this thread when done. :thumbsup:
Sam Torres: Uploading draft spec to internal doc now (will paste link once live).
Jordan Lee: Samples uploaded to s3://redwood-partner-samples/connectorX/staging — emailing partner access shortly.
Mia Patel: I'll schedule a 30m demo with partner Fri morning to walk through onboarding checklist. Thanks all!
